SqlAuthenticationInitializer.summary: Initializes authentication providers configured in app.config.
SqlAuthenticationInitializer.remarks: Configured initializers run synchronously during registry bootstrap without holding the lookup/publication lock. Concurrent and reentrant calls observe providers published so far. Only registrations made on the initializer's own thread receive configuration precedence. This uses the current managed thread ID, not logical async context or causal ownership. Work queued to another thread, including Task.Run work that this method waits for, uses application precedence and normal recoverable-error handling (SetProvider returns false). Same-thread calls made before an asynchronous operation yields still receive initializer handling while Initialize is running. Continuations on another thread do not. Initializer status ends when Initialize returns or throws. The registry does not await queued work or async-void continuations, and failures from that work are not automatically captured as initializer failures. GetProvider does not use this thread-ID check. Recoverable initialization or registration failures stop this initializer and are traced, but later configured providers are still attempted. Defaults cannot fill otherwise-unregistered methods after initializer failure because its intended methods are unknown. Explicit application registration can recover a missing method. Fatal failures propagate and are not cached by registry bootstrap. If execution continues, later access can retry bootstrap and repeat initializer side effects. Earlier registrations and initializer side effects are not rolled back. Enable tracing before the first registry access to capture these failures; recoverable initialization failures are not retried until the application restarts.

Initialize.remarks: This method executes without the lookup/publication lock. Concurrent and reentrant lookups observe providers published so far and can return null before a method has been initialized. Configuration precedence applies only to registrations made on this thread. Complete required registrations synchronously before returning; asynchronous work does not inherit initializer status through ExecutionContext flow.
